t: Contains the most popular sizes of flat and cone-point grub screws. For use in securing sliding or moving components. Supplied in a handy carry case with separate inner compartments.
b: Contents: Flat point (M3 x 10 (60), M4 x 16 (45), M5 x 20 (40) and M6 x 25mm (30)) and cone point (M3 x 10 (60), M4 x 16 (45), M5 x 20 (40) and M6 x 25mm (30)).
60° Thread to Secure Sliding or Moving Components
